integrity: Mathematical proof applies to any existing affine plane; executable finite checks illustrate and stress-test, not replace, the proof. No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite affine planes of order at least three; exactly one entire line parallel class removed; shortest-path vertex metric only. No automorphism representations; no existence claims. Finite verification is limited to coordinate orders three and five. Unindexed equivalent publications remain a risk.
title: Complete integral graph-metric Rips filtration after deleting an affine-plane parallel class
